title: PostgreSQL
description: PostgreSQL: health, per-service (application_name) load and latency p50/p95/p99, top and slow queries, logs, databases, tables, locks, WAL, vacuum. Data: postgres-exporter + statement log (Vector).

list.name: New image deployed
list.expr: (count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""}) unless count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""} offset 10m)) and on (name) (time() - container_start_time_seconds{name!=""} < 120)

list.name: application
list.label: Service (application_name)
list.description: application_name from the app's connection string. Clicking a service name in a table sets it too.

options.content: **How to read:** green = fine, yellow = watch, red = fix now. Click any card to open the matching detail panel full screen. Filter with `Service` / `Database` at the top, or click a service or DB name in any table. Rows below: **Services** → **Slow queries & p95** → **Logs** → Databases → Tables → Locks → Internals.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Whether postgres-exporter can connect. DOWN = database is down or the DSN is wrong.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the server started. Unexpectedly short = crash or OOM kill.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: PostgreSQL versiyasi.

panels.title: Connections used
panels.description: Share of max_connections in use. At 100% new connections are refused. Alert: 80%.

panels.title: Transactions/s
panels.description: Commits + rollbacks per second (TPS).

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of statements finish faster than this (from the statement log). Alert: 500 ms.

panels.title: Cache hit
panels.description: Share of block reads served from RAM (shared_buffers). 99%+ is normal for OLTP. Below 90% = reading from disk.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Postgres* alerts firing now.

panels.title: Blocked sessions
panels.description: Sessions waiting on another session's lock.

panels.title: Longest transaction
panels.description: Oldest open transaction. Long transactions hold locks and block VACUUM. Alert: 5 min.

panels.title: Idle in transaction
panels.description: Sessions that ran BEGIN and went quiet without COMMIT, usually an application bug.

targets.expr: sum(pg_app_activity_count{instance=~"$instance", application=~"$application", datname=~"$datname", state=~"idle in transaction.*"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Slow statements/min (>100ms)
panels.description: Statements slower than 100 ms, per minute.

panels.title: Errors/min
panels.description: ERROR/FATAL/PANIC lines in the PostgreSQL log, per minute.

panels.title: Deadlocks (range)
panels.description: Deadlocks in the selected range. Each one = one transaction killed.

panels.title: Databases size
panels.description: Total size of the selected databases.

panels.title: XID wraparound
panels.description: Share of the transaction ID limit (2^31) used. At 100% the database goes read-only and needs VACUUM FREEZE.

panels.title: Services overview
panels.description: One row per service (the app's application_name). Click a name to filter the whole dashboard to it. p50/p95/p99 = statement execution time (from the log). 'unknown' = apps that set no application_name.

targets.expr: sum by (application) (pg_app_activity_count{instance=~"$instance", application=~"$application", datname=~"$datname", state=~"idle in transaction.*"})

label_replace(1000 * histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, pg_app) (rate(vector_postgres_statement_duration_seconds_bucket{pg_app=~"$application", pg_db=~"$datname"}[5m]))), "application", "$1", "pg_app", "(.*)")

label_replace(1000 * histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, pg_app) (rate(vector_postgres_statement_duration_seconds_bucket{pg_app=~"$application", pg_db=~"$datname"}[5m]))), "application", "$1", "pg_app", "(.*)")

label_replace(1000 * histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, pg_app) (rate(vector_postgres_statement_duration_seconds_bucket{pg_app=~"$application", pg_db=~"$datname"}[5m]))), "application", "$1", "pg_app", "(.*)")

panels.title: p95 latency by service
panels.description: p95 statement time per service. When a line rises, find the heaviest query of that DB in 'Top queries'.

targets.expr: label_replace(1000 * histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, pg_app) (rate(vector_postgres_statement_duration_seconds_bucket{pg_app=~"$application", pg_db=~"$datname"}[5m]))), "pg_app", "(none)", "pg_app", "")

panels.title: p50 / p95 / p99 (selected services)
panels.description: Overall percentiles for the selected services/DBs. A big p99 vs p50 gap = a few very slow queries.

panels.title: Latency distribution (heatmap)
panels.description: Each cell = statements that ran at that speed at that time. Bright spots high up = a wave of slow queries.

panels.title: Statements/s by service
panels.description: Statements per second per service (from the log).

panels.title: Connections by service
panels.description: Connections held per service. A sudden rise = connection leak or pool misconfiguration.

panels.title: Connections by state
panels.description: active = running a query, idle = waiting in the pool, idle in transaction = a problem.

panels.title: What sessions wait on
panels.description: What active sessions wait on: Lock = another transaction, IO = disk, LWLock = internal contention, Client = the app is not responding.

targets.expr: sum by (application, wait_event_type) (pg_app_activity_count{instance=~"$instance", application=~"$application", datname=~"$datname", state="active", wait_event_type!="none"})

panels.title: Longest transaction by service
panels.description: Oldest open transaction per service.

panels.title: Idle in transaction by service
panels.description: Time spent idle inside a transaction. Alert: 5 min.

panels.title: Longest running query by service
panels.description: Longest currently running query, per service.

panels.title: Top queries — 30 most time-consuming
panels.description: pg_stat_statements: normalised queries ($1, $2 instead of values) over the selected range. 'Time share' = share of total DB time spent on the query; optimise from the top. Low cache hit or high temp = needs an index or more work_mem. Click a column to sort, use the filter icon to search.

panels.title: Time spent per query (top 10)
panels.description: Seconds per second the DB spends on the query (1 = one CPU core fully busy).

panels.title: Mean time per query (top 10 slowest)
panels.description: Mean time per execution since the last reset, so it moves slowly.

panels.title: Slow statement log (> 100 ms)
panels.description: Every statement slower than 100 ms from the PostgreSQL log, with real parameters. Expand a line for pg_app, pg_db, duration_ms.

targets.expr: service:="postgres" pg_app:~"${application:regex}" pg_db:~"${datname:regex}" "duration:" | extract "duration: <duration_ms> ms" | filter duration_ms:>100 | sort by (_time desc) | limit 500

panels.title: Slowest statements (selected range)
panels.description: Slow statements from the log grouped by text: count, slowest, average (ms).

targets.expr: service:="postgres" pg_app:~"${application:regex}" pg_db:~"${datname:regex}" "duration:" | extract "duration: <duration_ms> ms  <kind>: <stmt>" | filter duration_ms:>100 | stats by (pg_app, pg_db, stmt) count() hits, max(duration_ms) max_ms, avg(duration_ms) avg_ms | sort by (max_ms desc) | limit 30

panels.title: Log lines by level
panels.description: PostgreSQL log volume by level. Red error bars = a burst of errors.

targets.expr: service:="postgres" pg_app:~"${application:regex}" pg_db:~"${datname:regex}" | stats by (level) count()

panels.title: Errors by service
panels.description: Which service produces errors.

targets.expr: service:="postgres" pg_app:~"${application:regex}" pg_db:~"${datname:regex}" level:(error OR fatal OR panic) | stats by (pg_app) count()

panels.title: Errors, deadlocks, lock waits, temp files
panels.description: Important lines: ERROR/FATAL, deadlock detected, lock waits (log_lock_waits), temp files (work_mem too small), checkpoints too frequent.

targets.expr: service:="postgres" pg_app:~"${application:regex}" pg_db:~"${datname:regex}" (level:(error OR fatal OR panic OR warn) OR "deadlock" OR "still waiting for" OR "temporary file" OR "checkpoints are occurring") | sort by (_time desc) | limit 500

panels.title: Top error messages
panels.description: Most repeated errors.

targets.expr: service:="postgres" pg_app:~"${application:regex}" pg_db:~"${datname:regex}" level:(error OR fatal OR panic) | stats by (pg_app, _msg) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20

panels.title: All PostgreSQL logs
panels.description: All log lines (filtered). Full search: Logs dashboard.

targets.expr: service:="postgres" pg_app:~"${application:regex}" pg_db:~"${datname:regex}" | sort by (_time desc) | limit 1000

panels.title: Databases overview
panels.description: Each database: size, growth, 30-day forecast, load and health. Click a DB name to filter the dashboard.

targets.expr: sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_xact_commit{instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname", datname!~"template.*"}[5m]) + rate(pg_stat_database_xact_rollback{instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname", datname!~"template.*"}[5m]))

sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_xact_rollback{instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname", datname!~"template.*"}[5m])) / sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_xact_commit{instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname", datname!~"template.*"}[5m]) + rate(pg_stat_database_xact_rollback{instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname", datname!~"template.*"}[5m]))

sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname", datname!~"template.*"}[5m])) / sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname", datname!~"template.*"}[5m]) + rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname", datname!~"template.*"}[5m]))

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Size of each database.

panels.title: Transactions/s by database
panels.description: Commits and rollbacks. Rising rollbacks = application errors or deadlocks.

panels.title: Cache hit by database
panels.description: 99%+ yaxshi.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname", datname!~"template.*"}[5m])) / sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname", datname!~"template.*"}[5m]) + rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname", datname!~"template.*"}[5m])), "datname", "(none)", "datname", "")

panels.title: Rows read / written
panels.description: Rows per second, read and written.

panels.title: Rows returned vs fetched
panels.description: returned (scanned) much larger than fetched = many seq scans, missing index.

panels.title: Temp files & conflicts
panels.description: Temp = sorts/hashes spilled to disk (work_mem too small). Conflicts = queries cancelled on a replica.

panels.title: Tables overview
panels.description: Every table. Low index usage + high seq scans/s = missing index. High dead % = VACUUM is behind (bloat). Low HOT % = updates also write indexes (fillfactor). -1 = never vacuumed/analyzed.

panels.title: Largest tables
panels.description: 10 largest tables (including indexes).

panels.title: Sequential scans/s (top 10)
panels.description: Rows/s read by seq scans. High on a big table = candidate for an index.

panels.title: Dead rows (top 10)
panels.description: Dead rows waiting for VACUUM.

panels.title: Writes by table (top 10)
panels.description: Insert+update+delete rows/s.

panels.title: Vacuum & analyze runs
panels.description: Vacuum/analyze runs per hour.

panels.title: Unused indexes (no scans in the selected range)
panels.description: Indexes no query used: they still cost disk and slow every write. Check over a long range (7d+) before dropping; unique / primary-key indexes enforce rules even when never scanned.

targets.expr: sum by (datname, relname, indexrelname) (pg_index_size_bytes{instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}) and on (datname, relname, indexrelname) (sum by (datname, relname, indexrelname) (increase(pg_index_idx_scan{instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[$__range])) == 0)

panels.title: Blocked sessions by service
panels.description: Sessions waiting on another session's lock. Find the blocker: 'still waiting for' lines in Logs, or SELECT pid, pg_blocking_pids(pid), query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE cardinality(pg_blocking_pids(pid)) > 0;

panels.title: Longest lock wait by service
panels.description: Lock wait time. Alert: 60 s.

panels.title: Locks by mode
panels.description: Held locks by mode. AccessExclusiveLock = DDL (ALTER/DROP/VACUUM FULL), blocks everything.

panels.title: Deadlocks
panels.description: Deadlocks per 5 minutes. Cause: two transactions update rows in opposite order.

panels.title: Checkpoints
panels.description: Many requested = max_wal_size too small, checkpoints too frequent (IO bursts).

panels.title: Buffers written
panels.description: Who writes to disk. High 'backend' = queries must write themselves (bgwriter is behind).

panels.title: Checkpoint write / sync time
panels.description: Share of time spent writing and fsyncing checkpoints. High sync = slow disk.

panels.title: Buffers allocated
panels.description: Buffer allocation rate: data entering shared_buffers.

panels.title: WAL size
panels.description: Size of pg_wal. Constant growth = a stuck replication slot or archiving.

panels.title: Key settings
panels.description: Key settings (pg_settings).

panels.title: XID age by database
panels.description: Age of the oldest unfrozen transaction. At ~2.1 billion the database stops writes. Alert: 1 billion.

panels.title: Replication lag
panels.description: Meaningful on replicas only; 0 on a primary.

panels.title: Oldest transaction (any)
panels.description: Oldest transaction on the server (blocks autovacuum).

panels.title: Firing & pending alerts
panels.description: Postgres* alerts firing or pending now. Full list: Alerts dashboard.
